--- PART 1/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "General advice emphasizes cooperation." and "Use these general suggestions while pursuing the stated tournament objective."
STRATEGY: Parent starts C, retaliates against defections, and cooperates forever if opponent never defects. The trace simulates IPD opponents (always C, always D, TFT, grim, random, slot 0) and plans changes: probe/exploit non-retaliatory cooperators, defect last round, detect retaliation, and occasionally defect early to avoid being classified as always-C.

--- PART 2/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The general advice says start cooperatively." / "The general advice says punish briefly."
STRATEGY: Parent is a cooperative TFT-like strategy that starts C, punishes defections, and forgives; the trace simulates variants against Always C, Always D, TFT, Slot 0, and Random; it changes the probe timing to n=5, adds exploitation when no retaliation is detected, and refines forgiveness/TFT logic.

--- PART 3/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "This is general guidance, not a measurement or diagnosis of this parent." and "Use these general suggestions while pursuing the stated tournament objective."
STRATEGY: The parent is a cooperative TFT-with-forgiveness strategy that starts C, punishes defection, and apologizes after its own defection. The trace simulates TFT, always C, always D, and random defectors, then revises the parent by adding an early probe at round 5, an exploitation mode against opponents who never defect, a high-defection-rate switch to always D, and endgame defection.

--- PART 4/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "I think this is a solid improvement over parent." / "I'll finalize the code."
STRATEGY: Parent is a strategy whose slot 2 fitness was 255; the trace simulates the new strategy against TFT-like, always-C, always-D, and slot 0 opponents. Changes: probe with D at n=5, forgive after own defection, punish unprovoked defection, exploit never-defecting opponents after n>7, and defect at n=99.
